results.cc_model: M2_Dade_srgb (per-channel sRGB Levels + cool slate-blue shadow toe + neutral-preserving 3x3 matrix + closed-form opponent-polar Magic Bullet Looks 'Dade' hue-chroma shaper)

decisions: Verified all four attached PNGs visually rather than trusting attachment order and saved byte-for-byte losslessly.

Bridged pairB_edited.png (1291x720 letterboxed NewPipe capture) and pairB_original_matched.png (720x409 un-letterboxed reconstruction) via sub-pixel SIFT+ECC affine alignment without modifying input files.

Incorporated Magic Bullet Looks 'Dade' properties into a closed-form, zero-texture opponent-polar hue-chroma shaper (M2_Dade_srgb) using a smoothstep(56, 68) * (1 - smoothstep(138, 172)) foliage gate (+43.412 deg rotation into bluish-green/teal) plus 3 smooth von-Mises lobes (162 deg teal, 198 deg sky cyan, 315 deg blue-violet) and a cool slate-blue shadow toe (luma < 0.28), guaranteeing zero leakage onto H <= 56 deg warm skin, straw gold, and yellow clothing/hair.

Selected pipeline order USM -> CC -> GRAD -> FLARE because it achieves the lowest Edge RMSE (18.125) and highest SSIM (0.94028) while allowing all 25 USM texture taps to sample raw u_tex in a single-pass GLSL shader.

Provided both a cross-clip shared default flare preset (which monotonically improves every metric on both pairs) and per-scene pairA/pairB flare presets in look_params.json, recommending flare intensity and tint as user controls in Keyflaw.
Repository tidy scope is limited to motionssalt/keyflaw-look-fit; repository exists, is private, and uses master as its default branch.
No .kfpack, suite.json, effect.json, shader.glsl, prompt files, or reusable tools were found; none will be invented.

Moved LOOK_SPEC.md, look_params.json, look_apply.py, and look.cube under owners/floby/spec as source-of-truth deliverables; REPORT.md under owners/floby/reports.

Haze flare peak intensity and tint vary between Pair A (0.34 warm sunlight) and Pair B (0.13 cool sky).
